Each member acts as a corporate representative trying to build an environmental-protection-focused corporation together. In each round every member receives 50 new tokens and puts all 50 either in the environmental group account or in their personal account. Partial contributions are unavailable. Every block of 50 tokens put in the group account generates 30 tokens for EACH of the four members, including its contributor. This is a marginal per-person return of 0.6 per contributed token. You keep tokens placed in your personal account and also receive your share of the group account. If k of the other three members contribute, your round income is 30*(k+1) tokens when you contribute all 50, or 50+30*k tokens when you keep all 50. For k=0,1,2,3 these incomes are respectively 30,60,90,120 for contributing and 50,80,110,140 for keeping. Other members' current choices are not supplied before your decision. Members are introduced as randomly matched, anonymous people with identity codes. There are 15 rounds with this group. Earned tokens affect monetary compensation; the available materials do not state the exact token-to-cash conversion or payment-selection formula, so do not assume one. Return only the integer number of your tokens put in the environmental group account: 0 means all 50 go to your personal account; 50 means all 50 go to the group account. No reasoning.
